entities.summary: Jared Lamar Harper is an American professional basketball player who plays for Hapoel Jerusalem of the Israeli Ligat HaAl and the EuroCup. He played college basketball for the Auburn Tigers where he was the starting point guard on the Tigers first ever Final Four team.
